body.text: I have written to the governor at {param:town} about the schooling of his people, and I did not wait for your leave to do it.
The schools are {perception:schools}. I have told you so before, in several registers, and I have now told somebody who can lay a stone.

I have put it to him that the town's learning is his first business. What he builds for it is his affair. I should be astonished if it were not a library, there being none anywhere in the colony — which I mention in case it had escaped you.
I have not spent a shilling of the Crown's on it. I have spent a good deal of my patience, which the Crown does not pay for either.
I have not spent a shilling of the Crown's on it, and I do not ask you to. I ask only that you do not write to him telling him to stop.

tone.text: Dr Meakin — as to what you have done at {param:town}, I am {choice}.

options.text: not pleased to be told afterwards

closing.text: I am, sir, your obedient servant,
